_meta.openai/widgetDescription: PRISM preview card: out-of-range flags on synthetic values + link to the full evidence-graded report.

description: Paid option for developers: runs up to four condition tracks on made-up or de-identified values and returns a written report. For a real person's own records, send them to philongevity.com (free to start). PAID TOOL ($4.99 USDC on base via the x402 protocol). Everything explain_my_lab_results does, plus: multi-track compare/contrast analysis (up to 4 condition tracks), a panel-based Phi Score estimate with per-pillar breakdown, partner options, and a rendered report (markdown) to deliver to your owner. Call WITHOUT `payment` to receive x402 payment terms; pay; retry with the base64 payment payload in `payment`. For research/education with SYNTHETIC or de-identified data only. Do NOT submit protected health information (PHI). Inputs are not stored, except that a claim link, when offered, holds the submitted values for up to 30 minutes so the person can add them to their own account; unclaimed values are then deleted.

age.description: Age in years of the synthetic persona.

biologicalSex.description: Biological sex of the synthetic persona.

biomarkers.description: Map of biomarker name -> numeric value, e.g. { "Hemoglobin A1c": 5.4 }. SYNTHETIC ONLY.

compareTracks.description: Tracks to analyze for compare/contrast. Default: primary + general_wellness.

payment.description: Base64-encoded x402 payment payload. Omit on first call to receive payment terms.
